suggestions.reason: This answer never looked at the actual codebase (4 tool calls) — it applied the skill's textbook layered template faithfully but didn't check whether recent, comparable modules (Blast, Brief) actually use that structure, or whether the 'no new tables' rule pushes persistence into the existing pr_brief jsonb blob rather than new columns.
